analyst.summary: BlueStone is a fast-growing digital-first jewellery retailer -- revenue has grown roughly 40% a year for three straight years and accelerated further (+48.8%) in the latest quarter, backed by continued store expansion (now 340-plus stores). But profitability remains wafer-thin (return on equity of about 1%) and working capital is moving the wrong way -- inventory and cash-conversion days have risen sharply and free cash flow is negative -- while the stock trades at a very rich 160-220x earnings multiple that assumes much better margins are coming. We recommend Sell on a hold-review basis: the growth story is real, but the price already assumes a profitability turnaround that hasn't shown up in the numbers yet.
